schools.notes: Fee tables on sph.edu are campus tabs rendered by JavaScript (Framer). Static HTML only contains the default Lippo Village tab; the Sentul City figures were extracted from the page's own JS module (https://framerusercontent.com/sites/7L1moI0VPfdXxFQB7ZpJQM/xZd6uJevG.0E0Tbc57.mjs) by resolving the 'Sentul City' tab variant (desktop, tablet and mobile layouts agree except the 6-year DPP). Verbatim strings are the variant's cell texts joined with ' | '. YEAR LABEL CONFLICT: the English page heads these tables '2027/2028', while the Indonesian page (https://sph.edu/id/pendaftaran/biaya) shows the same figures under '2026/2027' headings. Recorded as 2027/2028 per the English page; treat the year as uncertain until confirmed with the school. Old URL sph.edu/id/pendaftaran/biaya/biaya-sekolah-sph-sentul-city/ now returns 404. Kabupaten Bogor assignment based on Sentul City location; no street address captured. Additional fees for some elective courses, field trips and Discovery Academy are mentioned but not priced.
